name: keepwright
desc: Quality architecture for any git repo, kept true
typing: Quality architecture for any git repo, kept true
Constitution, rules, CI and AI PR review in one plugin
Derives your patterns and turns them into validators
Set up once, audited over time
tagline: Set up and keep a high-quality engineering architecture in any git repo.
pitch: **keepwright** is a Claude Code plugin that implants a constitution, structured rules, GitHub Actions with AI PR review, portable validators and git hooks into any repo, then keeps auditing it so the architecture stays true instead of rotting.
notice: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. "Claude" and "Claude Code" are Anthropic trademarks.

what.product: Claude Code plugin for engineering quality architecture
what.installs: CLAUDE.md constitution · rules/ · validators · git hooks · GitHub Actions
what.ci: CI, AI PR review, @claude mention, safe auto-merge (human-gated for code)
what.derives: multi-agent workflows mine your design and writing-voice patterns
what.runtime: bun or Node 18+ (npx tsx); hooks in bash; macOS and Linux (WSL on Windows)
what.auth: OAuth token from the macOS Keychain, set as a repo secret
